t: You're on Pall Mall, a street in St James's that runs from St James's Street to Trafalgar Square. Its name comes from pall-mall, a ball game played here in the 17th century. Several notable people lived or died along it. The portrait painter Mary Beale died here, as did James Christie, who founded the auction house Christie's. The mathematician George Peacock and the Liberal politician Reginald McKenna died here as well, and so did Admiral Sir Robert Burnett. The 7th Duke of Bedford was born here.
